TWST.headline: TWST exhibits strong Stage 2 momentum and relative strength driven by biotech and AI demand.
TWST.technical_summary: Price is trading well above rising moving averages (10, 20, and 40 WEMA) with robust Mansfield Relative Strength across all timeframes. Although short-term volume accumulation is slightly negative and 10-day volume is in-line, the broader structural uptrend remains fully intact above the 82.6 volatility stop.
TWST.catalyst_summary: Recent positive momentum is supported by strong financial results and growing enterprise demand for AI-driven drug discovery applications, offsetting minor insider selling.
TWST.actionable_take: Look to accumulate shares on pullbacks toward the 82.6–83.8 support zone near the 10 WEMA and VStop level. Maintain a trailing stop discipline below the 82.6 mark to protect gains against short-term distribution.
